steps.caption: Agency workspace
steps.narration: This is the Agency workspace: every client's Google Business Profile locations in one list.

steps.caption: Filter by status
steps.narration: Filter by status: synced, needs reconnect, not linked, Watch alerts, unanswered reviews or failed posts.

steps.caption: One client at a time
steps.narration: Or pick one client. Choose Clearpeak Exteriors, and only their locations are left.

steps.caption: Each location as its Google listing
steps.narration: Each location shows as its Google listing, with its client and whether it's linked.

steps.caption: Tick the locations
steps.narration: To act on several at once, tick the locations you want.

steps.caption: Select all matching
steps.narration: Or choose Select all matching to take every location that fits your filters.

steps.caption: Pick the action
steps.narration: Then pick the action: sync, assign to a client, Watch mode, AI replies, a post batch, or Site Scans.

steps.caption: Set Watch mode
steps.narration: Set Watch mode asks which mode, and reminds you each location needs an approved snapshot first.

steps.caption: Queue selected action
steps.narration: Queue selected action runs it in the background, one job per location, and reports under Jobs.

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: Clients is where you add a client workspace, with a name and a contact email.

steps.caption: A client workspace
steps.narration: Each client keeps its email, folder, tags and notes.

steps.caption: Team
steps.narration: Team gives each person a role, admin, manager or viewer, and the clients they work on.

steps.caption: Onboarding
steps.narration: Onboarding emails a client the steps to add your agency as a Manager on Google. They keep ownership.

steps.caption: Menu: Agency
steps.narration: You'll find Agency in the menu on the left, under Google Business.

youtube.title: Agency workspace in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of the Agency workspace in ConstructHUB: every client's Google Business Profile locations in one list, filters by client and status, bulk actions queued across the locations you select, and the Clients, Team and Onboarding tabs.
